about: ADR-0088 preview-action-v1: the signed bytes of a preview.open sent through the hub. The domain `preview-action-v1`, one NUL byte, then F(node) F(`open`) F(port) F(expires_seconds) F(nonce) F(expires), concatenated, where F(x) is the decimal byte length of x, `:`, then x. Numbers are canonical decimal (no leading zeros, no `+`, no whitespace; `expires_seconds` 0 is `0`). `expires` is the signature's expiry in ms. Checked by crates/agora-protocol/tests/preview_signing.rs; the node, the terminal client and the web window check them when the open is built.

cases.name: node with a colon and a space
